video.title: Mountain Weather Update 10/28, Meteorologist Chris Tomer

description: PNW/BC snow continues with colder air.  This storm system digs south and hits the Intermountain West late 10/31-11/3 with falling temps and moderate to heavy snow accumulation.  This storm system is coldest intermountain storm system so far this season with lower elevation rain/snow lines.
